name: Tugongli
description: A naked-eye star 16.3 parsecs away, 1.9 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 215648: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.091 +/- 0.008 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.912 +/- 0.016

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 215648: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.192 +/- 0.011

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 215648: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6167 +/- 36

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 215648: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 61.37 +/- 0.2 mas, inverted

color.disagreement: Not explained. The Kharitonov color differs from the Pulkovo color by 13 levels in one channel, 1 over the agreement threshold. Both are ground spectrophotometry of the same star; the Pulkovo color is used because that catalogue comes first in the route order.

text.card: A naked-eye star 16 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.9 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.091 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.912 solar radii and 6,167 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 215648: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
